summary: Iteration 11 — ACTUAL EXECUTION of Layer #5 (Evaluation-Criteria Meta-Loop) + the 2 cosmetic fixes from iteration_10. 18/18 pytest cases passed against the public preview URL (/app/backend/tests/test_iteration11_eval_meta.py): GET /api/eval-weights is public (no session/auth headers) and returns exact defaults {coverage:0.4,rater:0.4,novelty:0.2} with is_default:true, updated_at:null, weights summing to 1.0, no _id leak; 3 rapid-fire POST /verify calls all 200 with no error surfaced and weights left untouched; check-edits with real changes (changed_files>=1) 200 OK, and the changed_files==0 path (recompute NOT called) also 200; composite_v2() re-verified by direct python import — weights=None == explicit 0.4/0.4/0.2, custom {0.6,0.2,0.2} produces a DIFFERENT (higher, as expected for cov>rater_norm) score, and the coverage gate still short-circuits regardless of weights; new_progress() carries eval_weights through (None for free tier). Direct DB inspection confirms the cleanup left a clean state: eval_weights doc has weights=defaults, updated_at=null, sample_size=11 (<15 MIN_SAMPLE_SIZE) and checked_at set by my /verify call — i.e. the below-threshold 'checked but not learned' branch works exactly as designed and get_weights() still reports is_default:true. Layer #7 regression: a real zip upload with a genuinely new modification now returns a non-null integer seconds_since_build inside the SAME check-edits response, and it matches the persisted row from GET /edit-diffs. Ran ONE fresh free-tier build end-to-end through /evolve + 11x /advance (teacher->artist->execute->correct->rate->score, plus the one refinement loop) — completed with status=complete, composite 1.1, and NO eval_weights field on the generation (correct for the 2-role path). Frontend (Playwright, 1920x1080): anonymous load makes ZERO /api/auth/me calls (previously on mount + every 60s) — only Neon's own /token 401s remain (out of scope); legacy chain without eval_weights renders COMPOSITE with no 'undefined%' and no eval-weights line; I temporarily stamped eval_weights onto my own test chain in the DB and confirmed the real JSX path renders 'scored via: cov 45% · rater 35% · novelty 20%' with data-testid eval-weights-1, then removed the stamp and re-verified the line disappears with no crash. Smoke: landing, pricing (3 plan cards), settings panel, chain history, download/push/upload-edits buttons, check-edits-btn + edit-diffs-panel ('58m after build' label rendering) all OK. No critical issues.

minor.issue: Pre-existing ENV limitation, not a regression: this env has no GROQ_API_KEY/GROQ_API_KEY_1..N configured, and free tier is Groq-only with fallback intentionally suppressed, so a default free-tier build fails at the Teacher stage with 422 'Teacher got no response from its model'. I had to save openrouter model assignments into /api/settings to get an end-to-end build. Any real anonymous free-tier user in this preview hits the 422.

sample_size is now 11 (not 0 as the request expected) because my /verify call legitimately triggered the below-threshold recompute branch which records sample_size+checked_at. Weights/is_default/updated_at remain defaults — informational, not a bug.

issues: /api/auth/me console noise is gone (0 calls). Remaining 401s in console come solely from Neon's own <NEON_AUTH_URL>/neondb/auth/token probe — out of scope per the request, but it still shows ~6-14 red 401 lines per session; consider gating that call on presence of a Neon session cookie if you ever want a fully clean console.

action_items: Optional (LOW): composite_v2 indexes w["coverage"]/w["rater"]/w["novelty"] directly — a partial/malformed eval_weights doc in Postgres would raise KeyError inside the score stage and fail the build. Use w.get(dim, DEFAULT_WEIGHTS[dim]).

Optional (LOW): /evolve passes eval_weights_doc["weights"] regardless of is_default; if a doc ever ends up with non-default weights but updated_at=null (partial write), the API would report is_default:true while builds are scored with the drifted weights. Consider serving DEFAULT_WEIGHTS whenever is_default is true.

Optional (LOW): maybe_recompute() is awaited inline inside /verify and /check-edits. Once sample_size clears 15 it scans up to 500 chains + 5000 edit_diffs rows on that one request per hour — consider BackgroundTasks so the user-facing verify click never pays for it.
Env (for future testing): set GROQ_API_KEY_1 (or equivalent) so default free-tier builds are exercisable without BYOK/settings overrides.
critical_code_review_comments: eval_meta._recompute() skips composite_gated builds from build_count — correct for signal quality, but it means a long streak of gated (broken) builds keeps sample_size below MIN_SAMPLE_SIZE indefinitely and the rubric never learns. Worth a comment/metric.

Throttle is keyed off checked_at persisted in the shared doc, so it holds across replicas — good. But the below-threshold branch overwrites sample_size with build_count each hour while leaving updated_at null; get_weights() correctly keys is_default off updated_at, so the API contract holds.

'good' = verified AND never in edit_diffs. A user who verifies and later uploads an edit flips that build to 'bad' retroactively, which is intended, but the corrected-set is computed from ALL edit_diffs rows (cross-tenant), consistent with the existing cross-tenant exemplar model.

_rater_norm is duplicated from chain_generator.composite() to avoid a circular import — acceptable, but the two must be kept in sync; a change to composite()'s coefficients would silently skew the meta-loop.

rca_of_the_issue: Free-tier 422 root cause: providers.TIER_ASSIGNMENTS['free'] routes all roles to groq, _call_role suppresses fallbacks for tier='free', and no GROQ_API_KEY* exists in /app/backend/.env, so openai_client_for('groq') returns None -> teacher_step gets empty output -> TeacherFailedError -> 422. Environment configuration, unrelated to Layer #5.
